notes: Outputs counts only. Corrected 2026-10-17 (analysis freeze-check item 9): census S opens the sealed SCREEN half and, of outcomes_guarded.csv.gz, only the side columns unit_id, side_market_id, side_token_index (to map prints to the rolled-into token; the read is logged in ACCESS_LOG.jsonl); census E computes mark-outs and flow in memory through the shared era helpers and census C computes C1 price differences in memory through c1_units, and both keep only count columns (cb4_analysis.census_frame drops every value column at once; any CENSUS_FORBIDDEN_COLUMNS name in a kept frame or in the census output refuses, unit-tested); no value, coefficient, mark-out or price change is written. The declared audits (side audits, t0 publicity, converged-price share) read prices and report shares only. Floors are never revised from the census; only H, rho (if the venue page differs) and extra UMA status strings may be pinned (cb4_declaration.ALLOWED_PINS). Runs after T4_dev_end (2026-10-25) and after the seal q0083 (T_seal 2026-10-22). Held behind q0086a_cb4_analysis_gate: the census code (cb4_analysis.cmd_census, cb4_rules, cb4_measure) must exist, be tested and pass the CB4 analysis freeze check first; q0084 and q0085 specs are not yet committed. depends_on as the CREATIVE_BATCH_4.md section 5 draft, plus the gate. 2026-10-17 (autopilot): also gated on q0086b, created only after the CB4 analysis freeze-check must-fixes 1-6 (science-reviewer 2026-10-17) are committed and re-checked; q0086a now releases only the uncounted pilot.
